name: openmerchant
description: Ask about your OpenMerchant vendor invoices and payments: what got paid, what is scheduled, what is waiting for a person, and which vendors need to send payout details. It never starts a payment.

interface.longDescription: Connect your OpenMerchant account to see your vendor invoices and payments: what was submitted, what got paid, what is scheduled, what is waiting for a person, and which vendors still need to send payout details. It can ask a vendor for missing payout details, which emails them a secure link. It never submits an invoice or approves, pays, cancels, or retries a payment; those stay in the OpenMerchant dashboard. You sign in with your OpenMerchant account and choose test or live mode.
defaultPrompt: Which vendor invoices did we pay this month?
Which invoices are waiting for me?
Do any vendors still need to send bank details?
